title: Write Execution Logs
why: The function must write its own logs. The log group is created in Terraform (see lambda.tf), so logs:CreateLogGroup is not granted (denied by default). Scoped to that one log group, not logs:* on *.

title: Read SSM Secret Parameter
why: The function reads exactly one application configuration secret. Only ssm:GetParameter is granted (no GetParameters, GetParametersByPath, or PutParameter), scoped to that single parameter ARN.
